title: A Busy Thursday
setting: A small house and a kitchen.

characters.name: Tom
characters.look: a young man with short brown hair

characters.name: Anna
characters.look: a young woman with long blonde hair

sentences.en: Tom wakes up at seven o'clock.
sentences.scene_prompt: a young man with short brown hair wakes up in bed at seven o'clock.

sentences.en: It is a sunny Thursday morning.
sentences.zh: 这是一个阳光明媚的星期四早晨。
sentences.scene_prompt: a young man with short brown hair looks out the window on a sunny Thursday morning.

sentences.en: He picks clothes in his bedroom.
sentences.scene_prompt: a young man with short brown hair picks clothes from a drawer in his bedroom.

sentences.en: Anna will let him use fruit.
sentences.scene_prompt: a young woman with long blonde hair lets a young man with short brown hair use a bowl of fruit.

sentences.en: She will cut fruit for juice.
sentences.scene_prompt: a young woman with long blonde hair cuts fruit on a kitchen table to make juice.

sentences.en: They even love this new month.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至很喜欢这个新月份。
sentences.scene_prompt: a young man with short brown hair and a young woman with long blonde hair smile together in the kitchen.

sentences.en: Strong men drink juice every minute.
sentences.zh: 强壮的男人每分钟都喝果汁。
sentences.scene_prompt: a strong young man with short brown hair drinks orange juice from a glass.
